name: Net Sales
description: Sales after recorded line discounts.

name: Total Orders
description: Distinct orders in the current filter context.

name: Avg Order Value
description: Net sales per distinct order.

name: Profit Margin %
description: Recorded line profit as a percentage of net sales; not an audited accounting gross margin.

name: Cost of Discounts
description: Sum of recorded line discount amounts; may differ slightly from rate-based arithmetic due to rounding.

name: Gross Profit
description: Legacy compatibility alias. Use Net Sales in report visuals; not gross profit.

name: Gross Margin %
description: Legacy alias; use recorded profit margin.

name: Profit Leakage Index
description: Discount share of sales before discounts, not causal profit leakage.

name: Unprofitable Orders Count
description: Distinct orders whose visible lines have negative aggregate recorded profit.

name: Unprofitable Orders %
description: Share of selected orders with negative aggregate recorded profit.

name: Avg Delivery Delta Days
description: Signed shipping-time difference to schedule; cancelled lines excluded.

name: Avg Delivery Delay (Days)
description: Average extra days among late delivered lines.

name: On-Time Delivery Rate %
expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(FactOrderItem), FactOrderItem[DeliveryStatus] IN {"Advance shipping", "Shipping on time"}), CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(FactOrderItem), FactOrderItem[DeliveryStatus] <> "Shipping canceled")) * 100
description: Early plus on-time lines as a share of non-cancelled delivered lines.

name: Late Delivery Rate
description: Late delivered lines / non-cancelled delivered lines.

name: Late Delivery Rate by Mode
description: Late delivered-line rate under shipping-mode filter.

name: Avg Days to Ship
description: Average actual shipping days for non-cancelled lines.

name: Customer Lifetime Value
description: Historical net revenue/customer; legacy name hidden, no future-value estimate.

name: Avg Revenue Per Customer
description: Historical net revenue per customer under current filters.

name: Sales per Customer
description: Historical net revenue per customer.

name: Active Products
description: Products with positive sales in the current fact context.

name: Product Margin %
description: Revenue-weighted recorded profit margin under product filters.

name: Top 20% Customer Sales %
expression: VAR Customers = ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES(FactOrderItem[CustomerKey]), "Revenue", CALCULATE([Net Sales])) VAR N = ROUNDUP(COUNTROWS(Customers)*0.2,0) VAR TopCustomers = TOPN(N, Customers, [Revenue], DESC, FactOrderItem[CustomerKey], ASC) RETURN DIVIDE(SUMX(TopCustomers,[Revenue]),[Net Sales])*100
description: Top ceiling(20%) of customers in selected fact context ranked by net revenue; deterministic key tie-break.

name: New Customers (Smart)
expression: VAR EndDate = MAX(FactOrderItem[OrderDate]) VAR StartDate = IF(ISFILTERED(DimDate),MIN(DimDate[FullDate]), EDATE(EndDate,-12)+1) RETURN CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(DimCustomer[CustomerKey]), KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(DimCustomer, DimCustomer[FirstOrderDate]>=StartDate && DimCustomer[FirstOrderDate]<=EndDate)))
description: First observed purchase within selected dates, or trailing 12 months; retains customer segment filters.

name: Sales Growth %
expression: VAR Prior = [Sales LY] RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(Prior) && Prior<>0, DIVIDE([Total Sales]-Prior,Prior)*100)
description: Same-period year-on-year gross-sales comparison; missing prior periods remain blank.

name: Latest Full-Year Sales Growth %
expression: VAR LastFact = CALCULATE(MAX(FactOrderItem[OrderDate]), REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate)) VAR Y = YEAR(LastFact)-IF(LastFact<DATE(YEAR(LastFact),12,31),1,0) VAR CurrentSales=CALCULATE([Total Sales],REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),DimDate[Year]=Y) VAR PriorSales=CALCULATE([Total Sales],REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),DimDate[Year]=Y-1) RETURN DIVIDE(CurrentSales-PriorSales,PriorSales)*100
description: Latest complete calendar year versus previous year, preserving non-date selections.

name: Sales 3M Moving Avg
expression: VAR Anchor = MAX(FactOrderItem[OrderDate]) VAR FirstMonth = EOMONTH(Anchor,-3)+1 VAR FirstData = CALCULATE(MIN(FactOrderItem[OrderDate]),REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate)) RETURN IF(FirstMonth>=FirstData, AVERAGEX(GENERATESERIES(0,2), VAR Offset=[Value] VAR EndDate=EOMONTH(Anchor,-Offset) VAR StartDate=EOMONTH(Anchor,-Offset-1)+1 RETURN CALCULATE([Total Sales], REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DATESBETWEEN(DimDate[FullDate],StartDate,EndDate))))
description: Average of three calendar-month gross-sales totals, retaining market/customer/product filters. Early incomplete windows are blank.
